[[Al-Wasl F.C.|Al Wasl]] 6–3 [[Al-Fujairah SC|Fujairah]] (1 November 2018) | matches = 168 | total goals = 605 | average goals = 3.6 | longest wins = [[Sharjah FC|Sharjah]] (9 games) | longest unbeaten = [[Sharjah FC|Sharjah]] (23 games) | longest winless = [[Dibba Al-Fujairah Club|Dibba Al Fujairah]] (13 games) | longest losses = [[Dibba Al-Fujairah Club|Dibba Al Fujairah]] (7 games) | highest attendance = [[Al Ain FC|Al Ain]] 1–2 [[Sharjah FC|Sharjah]] (18,103) | lowest attendance = [[Dibba Al-Fujairah Club|Dibba Al Fujairah]] 3–1 [[Al Dhafra FC|Al Dhafra]] (39) | average attendance = 464 | prevseason = [[2017–18 UAE Pro-League|2017–18]] | nextseason = [[2019–20 UAE Pro-League|2019–20]] | updated = 26 May 2019 }} The 2018–19, '''UAE Pro League''' was the 45th edition with Al Ain being the defending champions after winning their 13th title. Both Baniyas and Kalba returned to the pro league after getting relegated back at 2017. After losing Al Shabab and Dubai last season, the league has been reduced to 12 teams. Both the teams needed to get back to 14 teams so they held a relegation play off between bottom two teams of last year and the 3rd and 4th placed teams of the 2nd division. [[Sharjah FC|Sharjah]] set a record of the longest unbeaten run in a UAE Pro League season for 23 games before losing to Al Wasl 3–2. In 2019, [[Sharjah FC|Sharjah]] won their first title since [[1995–96 UAE Football League|1996]] after beating [[Al Wahda FC|Al Wahda]] 3–2, this was the first time a team outside of [[Emirate of Dubai|Dubai]] and [[Emirate of Abu Dhabi|Abu Dhabi]] won the league since the 1996. On 26 May, [[Emirates Club|Emirates]] and [[Dibba Al-Fujairah Club|Dibba Al Fujairah]] were relegated after a fixed match between [[Shabab Al-Ahli Dubai FC|Shabab Al Ahli]] and [[Fujairah Club|Fujairah]] favored Fujairah and got them out of relegation. The Emirates demanded that the UAEFA investigate on the match between Shabab Al Ahli and Fujairah, questioning the legitimacy of the two penalties that was rewarded to Fujairah and the two goals that was disallowed for Shabab Al Ahli.{{cite web|url=https://www.emaratalyoum.com/sports/local/2019-05-28-1.1217879|title=نادي الإمارات يطالب باتخاذ إجراءات مناسبة في فيديو الفجيرة وشباب الأهلي|date=27 May 2019 |publisher=الإمارات اليوم|access-date=28 May 2019}} However, the UAE court later rejected their complaint and the team got relegated.{{cite web|url=https://al-ain.com/article/emirates-club-issue-uae|title=لجنة الانضباط ترفض شكوى نادي الإمارات في واقعة ماجد ناصر|date=19 June 2019 |publisher=الرياضية|access-date=19 June 2019}} ==Changes== === To Division 1 === '''Relegated to [[2018–19 UAE Division 1|UAE Division 1]]''' *[[Hatta Club|Hatta]] === From Division 1 === '''Promoted to UAE Pro League''' *[[Baniyas Club|Baniyas]] *[[Ittihad Kalba FC|Ittihad Kalba]] *[[Fujairah FC|Fujairah]] ==Teams== ===Stadia and locations===
